data.name: Cook Together
data.detailed_description:
Cook Together

Cook Together is a chaotic co-op drug-creating game where you and your friend run a basement lab. You earn money by completing requested products. With that money, you can buy new equipment, expand your laboratory, and much more.

You can play in single-player or multiplayer, it's up to you. To play multiplayer, simply create a new game, open your friend list with Tab, and invite your friends. It's much funnier and more chaotic when played with a friend.

You can save the game by sleeping; in multiplayer, both players must be sleeping to save.

Cooking

The first rule is to always put on your suit before you start working—unless you want to die.
You can buy all your equipment from the laptop, and the items will be delivered through the tube.

To create Miguel’s Special:

  • Put the pills into the crushing bowl and crush them.

  • Pour the powder into a beaker, add a little water, then pour the mixture into the filter and start filtering.

  • While the filter is working, pour some ammonia into the petri dish. You can use the scale to find the best ratio.

  • Pour the mixture into the boiling flask.

  • Add the filtered solution to the flask, place the flask over the fire, and start cooking.

  • After cooking, pour the mixture into a tray and place the tray in the freezer. Wait a little.

  • Take out the frozen product, smash it into small pieces, pack them, seal the packs, put them in boxes, tape the boxes, and place them into the elevator.

  • Close the elevator.

That’s all you need to do.

Story

You are the chemist or chemists working for the big boss, Miguel. Create your product step by step, carefully. Don’t blow yourself up.

Finish the product in time, package it, and send it through the elevator.

If you fail to finish on time or ruin the purity, the boss won’t be happy.

He is extremely strict about time and purity.

Create high-quality products in a short amount of time.

Flies

Be careful with the flies. They can sneak in through the air vents and destroy your product’s purity. When you hear the fly alarm, find the fly and kill it immediately.

Finish the product in time without blowing yourselves up. Upgrade your lab, perfect the purity of your products and become the biggest producer in town.
